lead.headline: Deutsche Bank Opens Crypto Custody as Stablecoin Supply Records Largest Drop Since 2022
lead.tldr: Institutional infrastructure keeps arriving while on-chain liquidity contracts sharply. The gap between regulated entry points and actual deployable capital is widening.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why the infrastructure-buildout thesis is running ahead of the capital available to use it.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: Nvidia and Unity join Emulate’s $700m fundraise
top_signals.summary: Emulate has raised $700 million in a massive funding round. The round notably includes participation from Unity and NVentures, the investment arm of Nvidia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nvidia and Unity backing a $700M round signals that gaming/AI infrastructure convergence is attracting strategic capital at scale, even as pure crypto venture remains constrained.

top_signals.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
top_signals.summary: Deutsche Bank has officially launched a crypto custody service tailored for corporate and institutional clients. The service provides support for major assets including Bitcoin, Ether, and several stablecoins.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Deutsche Bank's custody launch marks a structural shift in European institutional access, creating competitive pressure on US incumbents who have delayed similar offerings.

top_signals.title: Stablecoin supply drops $14.2 billion in largest contraction since 2022 bear market
top_signals.summary: The stablecoin market has experienced a $14.2 billion contraction, the largest since the 2022 bear market. This decline, led by USDT and USDC, suggests a decrease in available buying power for a potential crypto market rebound.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A $14.2 billion stablecoin contraction removes the immediate fuel for price appreciation and forces underwriting of any rebound thesis to assume fresh fiat inflows rather than recycled on-chain capital.

top_signals.title: Nomura's Laser Digital helps launch Saudi SME credit vault targeting $100 million on BNB Chain
top_signals.summary: Nomura's Laser Digital has helped launch a Saudi SME credit vault on the BNB Chain, targeting $100 million in assets. The initiative aims to tokenize private credit for small and medium enterprises, with plans to expand into other emerging markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nomura's Saudi SME vault on BNB Chain demonstrates that tokenized private credit is migrating to lower-cost L1s as Ethereum fees and latency constrain institutional product design.

top_signals.title: OKXICE sets Nov. 23 launch for tokenized securities venue under SEC innovation exemption
top_signals.summary: OKX and ICE have announced the launch of a tokenized securities venue (TSV) scheduled for November 23. The initiative operates under a five-year innovation exemption granted by the SEC.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The OKX-ICE November 23 TSV launch under SEC exemption creates a controlled experiment for regulated tokenized securities trading that will either validate or invalidate the innovation-pathway model for US capital markets.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin Core discloses three patched security flaws, including high-severity mining bug
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin Core has disclosed and patched three security vulnerabilities, including a high-severity bug affecting mining. One of the flaws involved thousands of nodes incorrectly granting trusted permissions to incoming Tor connections.

on_the_radar.title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks31m, Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocksThe expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.
on_the_radar.summary: Kraken's parent company has expanded its xStocks platform by adding over 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including the entire DAX index. The move is part of a broader strategy to integrate traditional finance assets into the blockchain ecosystem, with future plans to expand into Hong Kong.

on_the_radar.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
on_the_radar.summary: Bitmine reported a massive net loss of $6.3 billion for fiscal 2026, primarily driven by a decline in Ether prices. Despite the loss, the company generated $124.8 million in revenue, mostly from staking and validation services.

on_the_radar.title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch
on_the_radar.summary: The European Central Bank has cautioned that legislative delays within the EU could push back the anticipated 2029 launch of the digital euro. Lawmakers are currently facing a critical year-end deadline to advance the necessary legal frameworks.

on_the_radar.title: Bitmine reports $6.3 billion net loss in latest fiscal year, driven by 44% ether decline
on_the_radar.summary: Bitmine reported a massive net loss of $6.3 billion for its latest fiscal year. The loss was primarily driven by a 44% decline in the value of Ether, resulting in $6.23 billion in unrealized fair value losses.

on_the_radar.title: Nvidia perps plunge 10% on Hyperliquid as board reportedly weighs ousting Jensen Huang
on_the_radar.summary: Nvidia perpetual contracts on Hyperliquid dropped 10% following reports that the company's board is considering removing CEO Jensen Huang. The reported move stems from allegations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.

on_the_radar.title: SEC enters fight over who regulates perpetual derivatives on stocks in the US
on_the_radar.summary: The SEC has filed an amicus brief supporting the CFTC in a legal battle over the regulation of perpetual derivatives on stocks in the US. This follows a lawsuit by the Capital Markets Alliance attempting to overturn the approval of these products.

on_the_radar.title: Apex Group joins Hedera Council to explore tokenization and settlement
on_the_radar.summary: Apex Group has joined the Hedera Council to collaborate on tokenization and settlement solutions. This partnership aims to further integrate blockchain infrastructure and stablecoins into traditional financial services.

linkedin_post:
Deutsche Bank now holds Bitcoin and stablecoins for institutions. The same week, stablecoin supply dropped $14.2 billion—the largest drain since the 2022 collapse.

We are building rails faster than we are filling the trains.

The custody announcement matters because it removes a final objection from European treasury desks and fund boards. Deutsche is not a crypto-native experimenting with product-market fit. It is a systemically important bank with a balance sheet that makes Coinbase look like a startup. When it commits to cold storage and insurance frameworks, the compliance cost of saying 'no' to crypto rises for every peer still on the sidelines.

But the stablecoin contraction says the capital that would actually move through those rails is leaving. USDT and USDC reductions mean less dry powder sitting on-chain, less immediate bid support, and a market that needs genuine new inflows rather than rotational liquidity to sustain any December rally. Options markets are pricing sub-$70,000 Bitcoin with conviction.

This is the repricing we are underwriting now: infrastructure value accrues on a different timeline than token value. The banks and exchanges building custody, tokenized securities venues, and regulated on-ramps are positioning for a market structure that assumes institutional participation as inevitable. The stablecoin data says that participation, measured in actual deployed dollars, is not here yet.

Our watchpoint is whether the November 23 OKX-ICE tokenized securities launch draws meaningful flow, or whether it launches into the same thin air. That will tell us which gap closes first.
